title: cynometra copelandii
intro: Cynometra copelandii, commonly known as the Philippine ironwood or Cebu ironwood, is a species of tree in the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cynometra copelandii include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. These constituents are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
